title: Markov choice of r ∈ (ρ/2, ρ) off a null set with ofReal(F′(r)) ≤ (4/ρ)·B (Simon 6.5.1 (10))
statement: Let F : ℝ → ℝ be monotone (nondecreasing), let ρ > 0 be real, let B ∈ [0, ∞], and let N ⊆ ℝ be Lebesgue-null (volume N = 0). Suppose ofReal(F(ρ) − F(ρ/2)) ≤ B. Then there is r with ρ/2 < r < ρ and r ∉ N such that ofReal(F′(r)) ≤ ofReal(4/ρ)·B. Here F′ = deriv F (Mathlib's derivative, equal to 0 where F is not differentiable), ofReal = ENNReal.ofReal, and the product is taken in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (B : ℝ≥0∞) (N : Set ℝ), Monotone F → 0 < ρ → ENNReal.ofReal (F ρ - F (ρ / 2)) ≤ B → (volume : Measure ℝ) N = 0 → ∃ r ∈ Ioo (ρ / 2) ρ, r ∉ N ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (deriv F r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4 / ρ) * B
